How we work

## Values & principles.

The operating system behind every team at Vim.

### \#vimandvigor

We have a fiery soul — positivity, optimism, and outstanding energy. We take our mission seriously without taking ourselves too seriously, and we have fun doing it.

### \#ideameritocracy

The best ideas always win. Everyone puts honest, diverse thoughts on the table, we debate openly, then commit and move forward together.

### \#ownit

We’re owner-operators — biased toward action and accountable for results. We back positions with data: not “I think,” but “let me show you.”

### \#winasateam

We work and win as a team. We build trust through open communication, internal equity, empathy, and humility — a choice we make every day.

### \#radicalcandor

Radical candor and operational transparency everywhere. Vocally self-critical, quick to credit others, first to own mistakes — always doing the right thing.

Our team enjoys

## Real work, _at_ human scale.

### Flexible work environment

Hybrid or remote, whichever lets you do your best work.

### Unlimited PTO

Take the time you need; we trust you to balance it.

### Full benefits

Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), parental leave, and more.

### Competitive comp

Top-of-market salary and meaningful equity in a real company.

### Growth opportunities

Small team, big problems. Real ownership from day one.

### Transparency

Honest goals, honest feedback, no theater.
